main_idea: Training lifts Qwen3.5-9B pass@5 on τ³-Banking from 11.3% to 17.5%.
ideas: Training raised pass@5 on τ³-Banking from 11.3% to 17.5%
Distilling a larger teacher, then pivot RL, drove the gain
Evaluated on 97 tasks with 5 attempts each
Six general benchmarks showed no significant change
summary: A clear before/after chart is the main visual, but the method cards, the dataset stats row, the duplicate wordmark and the badge are clutter, and the headline and subtitle are wordy; nothing essential is missing.
